headline: Jensen Huang's allies push for his return as Nvidia CEO
summary: Allies of Jensen Huang are working to secure his reinstatement as Nvidia CEO just days after his resignation amid scandal.

claims.statement: Jensen Huang's allies are working to get him back as Nvidia CEO just days after his resignation.

sources.quote: allies rally to push the AI chipmaker to take him back just days after he was ousted
Huang is weighing a return just days after resigning amid a deepening scandal.

claims.statement: Huang's allies have formed a "war room" to drive his reinstatement.

sources.quote: Jensen Huang allies build a "war room" to get him back at Nvidia
